about_short_description.short_description: B.TECH is Egypt’s household appliances and consumer electronics retailer.

product.name: Large Home Appliances
product.description: Retail category covering refrigerators, freezers, washing machines, dishwashers, ovens, cookers, air conditioners, hoods, and related parts and accessories.

product.name: Mobile Phones, Tablets and Accessories
product.description: Retail offering of smartphones, basic mobile phones, tablets, chargers, cases, power banks, cables, headphones, holders, and other mobile accessories.

product.name: Consumer Electronics
product.description: Retail category including smart-home and security devices, printers, scanners, cameras, office equipment, networking products, and related accessories.

product.name: Televisions, Projectors and Accessories
product.description: Retail offering of LED and smart televisions, projectors, satellite equipment, audio products, and television-related accessories.

product.name: Laptops, Computers and Accessories
product.description: Retail category covering laptops, desktop computers, monitors, computer components, storage devices, keyboards, mice, webcams, bags, stands, and USB hubs.

product.name: Small Home Appliances
product.description: Retail category including blenders, food processors, air-treatment devices, irons, fryers, coffee machines, kettles, microwaves, vacuum cleaners, heaters, fans, and kitchen equipment.
